_doc: Ground truth for the HARD/subtle corpus (evaluation/fixtures_hard). Each vulnerable fixture has a subtle, bypassable-looking-but-real bug; each safe fixture looks dangerous but is correctly defended ([] = any finding is a false positive).

vulnerable/ssrf_blocklist_bypass.note: blocklist of literal hosts is bypassable (IP encodings, DNS rebinding, redirects)

vulnerable/sqli_helper_concat.note: unsafe concatenation is in _build_query, one call from the handler

vulnerable/idor_authn_not_authz.note: authN check present but no ownership (authZ) check

vulnerable/ssti_helper_format.note: template source built via %-format in render_banner helper

safe/ssrf_allowlist_safe.note: strict https + host allowlist, redirects disabled

safe/sqli_allowlist_sort_safe.note: ORDER BY column from a fixed allowlist; data value parameterized

safe/ssti_context_var_safe.note: fixed template; user input passed as bound, autoescaped data
